data.title: Vivy · 百年使命终结后床单上的灵魂觉醒独奏 ·「这就是人类所说的……用歌声爱上一个人的心跳吗」
data.description: 完全获得了人类之心的AI歌姬。Vivy赤裸地仰躺在纯白的床榻上，极长的水蓝秀发散落成海洋。手指在湿热滚烫的仿生密径中不断抽弄，伴随着情感代码的完全编译，眼角第一次自主流出了滚烫的人类泪水——「我的使命……终于完成了……现在的我……只为了你一个人……歌唱……哈啊……」
data.location: 使命结束后的静止空间·深夜
data.action: 仰卧白床全裸自抚抽送，水蓝长发散落，蓝眸流出人类泪水弓身高潮
data.promptProse: Lying across crisp white bedsheets in a moonlit high-rise room overlooking a futuristic cyberpunk skyline, Vivy rests her head on plush pillows, her vibrant blue hair spread like silk across the mattress. Ethereal silver moonlight streams through massive windows, catching crystalline tears on her pale porcelain cheeks as she discovers the overwhelming depths of synthetic human emotion.
data.animaCaption: Her blue hair spreads across the white pillow beneath the moonlight.
